title: Stock Radar: Concord Biotech stock showing signs of rebound after falling over 20% from highs; time to buy?
summary: Concord Biotech stock shows a breakout from a seven-month consolidation phase. Experts suggest buying the stock for a target above 1,500 levels. The pharma stock experienced a significant fall after reaching record highs previously. It has since formed a strong base and is trading above key moving averages. Momentum indicators support a bullish outlook for the stock in the coming weeks.

title: Oil Extends Two-Day Drop on Signs of Progress Toward Hormuz Deal
summary: Oil fell for a third day on optimism a deal can be reached that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, freeing up supply trapped in the Persian Gulf.

title: Adani's bumper capex trickles down to smaller infra firms
summary: The Adani Group’s  ₹1.53 trillion capex plan for FY26 is emerging as a major growth driver for smaller listed engineering and construction companies. For some, the conglomerate accounted for over 80% of new orders last year, reflecting its growing influence on India’s EPC ecosystem.
